# Graphs

{{< include _setup.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| include: false

library("mlr3verse")
library("mlr3proba")
```

Graphs are predefined arrangements of `r ref("PipeOp")` objects from the `r ref_pkg("mlr3pipelines")` package.
The goal is to simplify some popular operations which usually consist of multiple steps.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| column: page

rd_tag = function(rd, tag) {
  Filter(function(x) identical(attr(x, "Rd_tag"), tag), rd)
}

help_pages = rbindlist(map(grep("^mlr3", loadedNamespaces(), value = TRUE), function(pkg) {
  rbindlist(map(tools::Rd_db(pkg), function(rd) {
    data.table(
      alias = unlist(rd_tag(rd, "\\alias")),
      label = trimws(paste(unlist(rd_tag(rd, "\\title")), collapse = "")),
      package = pkg
    )
  }))
}))

content = as.data.table(mlr_graphs)
content[, constructor := map(key, function(value) mlr_graphs$items[[value]]$value)]
content[, topic := sprintf("mlr_graphs_%s", key)]

documented = content[topic %in% help_pages$alias]
content[topic %nin% help_pages$alias, topic := map_chr(constructor, function(value) {
  index = which(map_lgl(documented$constructor, identical, value))
  if (length(index)) documented$topic[index[1L]] else NA_character_
})]

content = help_pages[content, .(key, label = sub("\\.$", "", label), package, topic), on = c(alias = "topic"),
  mult = "first"]

ref_cell = function(value, index) {
  if (is.na(content$package[index])) return(value)
  mlr3website::ref(content$topic[index], text = value, format = "htmltools")
}

reactable(content, columns = list(
    key = colDef(name = "Key", cell = ref_cell),
    label = colDef(name = "Label", na = ""),
    package = colDef(name = "Package", cell = function(value) if (is.na(value)) "" else package_cell(value)),
    topic = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  searchable = TRUE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```
